QuestInfo.name: The Secret Mission
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p1101002# has a new mission for you...
QuestInfo.1: You must go to Ludibrium Library and take the Book of Ancient to Ereve.
QuestInfo.2: Wiz the Librarian told you where to find the book.

0.0: I have a job for you. I expect you to handle it quickly and discreetly.
0.1: Retrieve a book from Wiz the Librarian at the #b#m222020000##k. Don't ask questions. Just be quick about it.\r\nI'll send you to the library entrance right away.

yes.0: Retrieve a book from Wiz the Librarian at the Ludibrium library. Don't ask questions. Just be quick about it.

no.0: Tsk, and you say you want to become a knight.

1.0: Ah, a Cygnus Knight enters the presence of this humble yet wise-and-powerful librarian...
1.1: Is the young knight a lover of books? Indeed, the young knight is! Wiz the Librarian senses this at once with his laser-sharp book-loving skills!

yes.0: If the young knight will please wait just a moment...

npc.0: I'm sure Wiz the Librarian at the Ludibrium Library does NOT have all day...
